label: canon-dams-aiself-n1
_why: THE ENGINE AI BUILDING THE DAMS ITSELF, over a century (user, 2026-09-27: remove the scripted queue adds - the AI may have never built a dam only because the dams lacked an ownership_type). ARM = config/mod_config.canon-dams-aiself.json {kind: config}: the canon (canon-dams, 144 projects / 312 levels) + ownership_type = self on every dam (now in the canon generator too) + dams.ai.driver_build = false and driver_finance = false: the quarterly driver only SURVEYS; no start_building_construction, no financed level. Every dam level is the engine AI own choice. Fixed n=1, plays to 1936, no stop watcher.
_arm: config/mod_config.canon-dams-aiself.json (+ tech_tree_options twin = the canon twin, byte-identical)
_comparison: canon-dams-v3-n3 (20260927_001731: 92-101 levels built per healthy run, dam electricity 43-44% of the world at 1935, 8-11 dam items in government queues, financing by 3-7 overlords) - but that book had 159 projects and no ownership_type; the shipped canon (144 projects) is itself unmeasured. Pinned vanilla n=16 (20260821_131149) for the register.
_instrument: identical to canon_dams_n1: the canon telemetry + PMR_DAM debug.log lines (survey_*, stage_start, built / complete, finance_start / finance_done, bur_year) + yearly save summaries (building_dam_* per country, ownership levels by owner class).
_stop_rule: fixed n=1: plays to 1936, no stop watcher

_predictions.construction: the AI builds dams on its own: at least 20 levels by 1936 (the driver built 92-101); if under 5, the ownership_type was not the cause of F169 and the driver returns
_predictions.where: mostly in the builders own states; levels in a subject state owned by the overlord only if the government AI uses its foreign construction for them
_predictions.ownership: every level owned by a country; none by a financial district or company (can_build_private stays always = no)
_predictions.economy: world GDP inside the canon seed spread (0.68-1.04); fewer dams means more coal plants, not less electricity
_predictions.perf: play time within 5% of the canon on a quiet machine
